note: Both conditions of the terminal weight appear as the hypotheses hL, hp of joins, and terminalAfford shows they hold eventually. The first uses the transported weight `march` in place of varpi(a_m/a_k*)^{t+1} z_{t,m}/z_{t,k*}, and the second uses ||alto|| and 1/gainChart in place of a_{k*}^{-t} and (a_m/a_{k*})^{1/8}, so the conditions are packaged abstractly.
